name: Onesource Ideas Venture Limited
summary: Headquartered in Chennai, India, Onesource Ideas Venture Ltd., founded on December 8, 1994, offers specialized financial advisory and consultancy services. The firm primarily operates in investment banking and comprehensive restructuring solutions. Its service portfolio encompasses guiding clients through mergers and acquisitions, executing business and financial restructurings, devising turnaround strategies, securing acquisition financing and leveraged buyouts, recapitalizing companies facing financial distress, engineering promoter equity restructurings and funding, advising on initial public offerings (IPOs) and capital market fundraising, and facilitating venture capital and private equity investments.
